data.one_liner: Encoding and decoding library for the vector_graphics binary format
data.what_it_does: Provides the low-level binary encoder and decoder used by vector_graphics and vector_graphics_compiler. It serializes vector graphics commands into a compact binary format and decodes them back for rendering. The package is strictly an internal building block and is not intended for standalone use.
use_when: Building custom vector graphics tooling or compilers that target the package:vector_graphics format
Extending or debugging the binary serialization pipeline between vector_graphics_compiler and vector_graphics
avoid_when: Developing regular Flutter apps where you only need to display SVGs or vector assets (use vector_graphics or flutter_svg instead)
You require a stable serialization format across major/minor versions
strengths: Highly optimized binary format for fast decoding and small payload sizes
weaknesses: Explicitly offers no format stability guarantees across versions
Not intended for direct general use outside vector_graphics companion packages
data.setup_notes: Internal encoding utility; usually pulled in transitively rather than manually configured.
